ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34C.11 Haul-to-Inventory Parallel Eligibility
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-C.11 for RimWorld 1.5. Adds a targeted Pick Up And Haul storage-eligibility fabric. Small main-thread slices capture primitive candidate IDs, priorities and destination-acceptance bytes; workers compile structural negatives; every rejection is proved again against live storage settings before the expensive original storage-cell search may be skipped. Reservations, forbidden state, reachability, Job creation and final storage selection remain live and Vanilla-authoritative. T34-C.10 target-count aggregation remains active.
